newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar sees August premium widening at close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar sees August premium widening at close.

text.p: The premium for near August LIFFE sugar continued to widen upto the close when it stood at around $10 a tonne over October.
The main activity was switching between the two positions ahead of near August's expiry and out of the total turnover of 3,321 lots, over 3,000 lots were in August and October.
August closed $4.90 a tonne higher from Friday.
In Paris 45 ICUMSA closed with August $2.50 a tonne higher at $324.00 while 100 ICUMSA was tradeless.
